explication: Staticcheck is a Go static-analysis suite: its main workflow loads packages, runs registered checks, and presents diagnostics, with cache-backed execution. Its checks include bug/performance diagnostics, simplifications, style rules, and unused-code analysis. The README also documents separate struct-layout tools. The graph preserves those product branches and the IR/dataflow analysis layer; some subsystem links rely on README descriptions or indexed references rather than complete source excerpts.
